project_type: Next.js 16 App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4 + MongoDB, Indian fintech trading platform demo
build_system: Next.js 16.4.3 with Turbopack (via `next dev`). CRITICAL BREAKING CHANGES vs earlier versions: (1) `middleware.ts` is DEPRECATED — use `src/proxy.ts` with export named `proxy` (not `middleware`); (2) dynamic route `params` is a Promise — must be `await`ed inside async page components; (3) route handler `params` also Promise — `const { symbol } = await params`. Read node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/proxy.md before writing proxy.ts.
test_framework: None configured. Verification = `npm run build` passing (no TypeScript errors, no missing imports).
verification_instructions: After implementing each feature: (1) run `npm run build` from the PYTRADE workspace root — it must complete with 0 errors; (2) confirm the new routes appear in the build output; (3) run `npm run dev` and manually verify the pages render at 375px and 1440px. Fix all TypeScript errors before considering a step done.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Workspace root: c:\Users\DELL\OneDrive\Desktop\PYTRADE. All file paths must be absolute or relative to that root. Do NOT write files outside the workspace. The .env.local file must NOT be committed — add it to .gitignore if not already present.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md states: this is Next.js 16 with breaking changes — read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing any code. Never break / or /dashboard routes. Never duplicate existing components, mocks, or utilities.
key_patterns: 1) All interactive/Redux-consuming components must have 'use client' at top. 2) Server components (pages that only read data) should NOT have 'use client'. 3) Tailwind v4 custom tokens: text-pytrade-blue, bg-pytrade-navy, text-positive, text-negative, bg-page-bg, bg-card-bg — use these, never hardcode hex. 4) All new app pages (except auth/onboarding) must be wrapped in <AppLayout>. 5) Import patterns: ui components from '@/components/ui', formatters from '@/lib/formatters', utils from '@/lib/utils', mocks from '@/mocks/*', store from '@/store/index'. 6) Button variants: primary/secondary/ghost/danger with size sm/md/lg and fullWidth/loading props. 7) Card/DashboardCard for card containers. 8) Mobile-first: tables get overflow-x-auto, mobile list views below sm breakpoint. 9) Demo disclaimers on every financial data page (amber warning box pattern from PortfolioSummary.tsx). 10) PIN stored in component state only — never persisted anywhere.

src/components/ui/Modal.tsx — Modal (bottom sheet mobile, centered desktop)
src/components/charts/PortfolioChart.tsx — AreaChart with time range selector (Recharts pattern)

src/store/index.ts — Redux store, add new reducers here
src/lib/formatters.ts — formatINR, formatPercent, formatChange, formatDate, formatTime, formatVolume
src/types/order.ts — Order, OrderSide, OrderType, OrderStatus types
src/server/db/mongoose.ts — stub to be replaced with real connection
src/features/dashboard/MarketOverview.tsx — pattern: tabs + search + sortable table + mobile list
src/features/dashboard/RecentOrders.tsx — pattern: tabs + desktop table + mobile cards
directory_structure: src/app/ — Next.js App Router pages and API routes; src/components/ — shared UI (ui/, layout/, charts/, landing/); src/features/ — feature-specific components (dashboard/); src/store/ — Redux slices and store; src/mocks/ — static demo data; src/lib/ — utilities and formatters; src/types/ — TypeScript type definitions; src/server/ — server-only code (db/, models/, auth); src/config/ — config files like navigation.ts
